# Noom Sound Studio

> Sound healing and handpan lessons on an open-air terrace in Lamai, Koh Samui, Thailand. Live handpan, gong, crystal and Tibetan bowls, played by two musicians while you lie down and rest.

Noom Sound Studio is run by Can (Kazimcan Kiyak) and Melie. Sessions are held on a covered terrace five minutes from Lamai beach, and at villas, hotels and retreats across Koh Samui. Sessions run in English. Eight mats per session.

## What we offer
- Sound journey (sound bath) — 75 minutes, ฿600 per person for a group session
- Private sound journey at the studio — from ฿2,500 for two, +฿500 per extra guest up to seven
- Sound journey at your villa or hotel — from ฿4,000 for two, +฿500 per guest up to ten
- Handpan demo lesson — ฿2,000, instrument provided, no experience needed
- 3-Day Handpan Journey — the signature beginner course
- 8-lesson handpan course
- The Regulars pass — ฿2,000 for four sessions, valid one year, transferable
- Children's rhythm workshop — Wednesdays at Mulajoy, ages six to fourteen, by contribution

## Regular schedule
- Wednesday 17:30 — Noom Terrace, Lamai. 75 min, ฿600
- Sunday 17:30 — Noom Terrace, Lamai. 75 min, ฿600
- Full moon 18:00 — location announced monthly. 75 min, ฿600
- First Thursday 17:00 — monthly sound therapy at Mulajoy. 60 min, ฿650
- Every Wednesday 11:00 — children's rhythm workshop at Mulajoy
